Apple's next-generation iPhone Pro model is expected to feature a brand-new all-glass design, commemorating the 20th anniversary of the iPhone. Yesterday, we compiled the latest developments on Apple's innovative model for you.

Here are the latest updates on Apple's unique iPhone 20 Pro design

The innovative iPhone Ultra (Apple's first foldable model) will make its debut in a few weeks, but next year will bring another distinctly different new iPhone design.

Reports suggest Apple is preparing a special all-glass design for next year's iPhone Pro model. The new device is said to feature a larger display with curved screens on all four sides, extending to the edges of the body for a truly bezel-less visual effect.

Yesterday, Weibo tipster '定焦數碼' updated Apple's progress on this unique design in a new post.

They pointed out that Apple adopted the same glass assembly process previously used for the iPhone Air, but with improvements to incorporate more curved materials.

The post also noted improvements in two areas:

  • Thermal performance
  • Body thickness

It remains difficult to determine Apple's target specifications regarding thickness and design materials. However, all indications so far suggest this new device will draw inspiration from the iPhone Air and Ultra, but will not prioritise slimness as those two models do.

According to the latest news, the new device appears to combine the design innovations of the iPhone Air and Ultra, while delivering performance and battery life that meet—or even approach—what Pro users expect.

Pro users don't want to sacrifice performance for a thinner body. But if Apple could launch a slightly slimmer model with a unique all-glass aesthetic while maintaining a comparable user experience, it would be extremely appealing.

How interested are you in next year's rumoured iPhone Pro 20 model? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
